changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'usage' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Analytic') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [usage].[Analytic]( [Id] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [UserId] [int] NOT NULL, [Timestamp] [datetime] NULL, [IpId] [bigint] NULL, [Browser] [int] NOT NULL, [Language] [char](2) NOT NULL, [Locale] [char](5) NOT NULL, [Action] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetId] [bigint] SPARSE NULL, [AssetTypeId] [int] SPARSE NULL, [DashboardId] [int] SPARSE NULL, [IssueId] [bigint] SPARSE NULL, [SemanticId] [bigint] SPARSE NULL, [TagId] [int] SPARSE NULL, [TabId] [int] SPARSE NULL, [SidebarId] [int] SPARSE NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Usage_Analytic] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [Id] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Usage_Analytic_AssetId') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Usage_Analytic_AssetId] ON [usage].[Analytic] ( [AssetId] ASC ) include (UserId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Usage_Analytic_AssetTypeId') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Usage_Analytic_AssetTypeId] ON [usage].[Analytic] ( [AssetTypeId] ASC ) include (UserId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Usage_Analytic_DashboardId') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Usage_Analytic_DashboardId] ON [usage].[Analytic] ( [DashboardId] ASC ) include (UserId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Usage_Analytic_IssueId') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Usage_Analytic_IssueId] ON [usage].[Analytic] ( [IssueId] ASC ) include (UserId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Usage_Analytic_SemanticId') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Usage_Analytic_SemanticId] ON [usage].[Analytic] ( [SemanticId] ASC ) include (UserId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Usage_Analytic_TagId') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Usage_Analytic_TagId] ON [usage].[Analytic] ( [TagId] ASC ) include (UserId) END
